summaries.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Transformers are SSMs** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖状态空间模型（State Space Model (SSM)），并引入 state space
duality (SSD) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We show that these families of models are actually quite closely related, and develop a rich framework of theoretical connections between SSMs and variants of attention,...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用线性复杂度递归状态/注意力融合架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our state space duality (SSD) framework allows us to design a new architecture (Mamba-2) whose core layer is an a refinement of Mamba's selective SSM...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **8X faster**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（While Transformers have been the main architecture behind deep learning's success in language modeling,...；We show that these families of models are actually quite closely related, and develop a rich framework of...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 68 赞），本工作为突破 **状态空间与线性注意力 (SSM/Mamba)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Video-MME: The First-Ever Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark of Multi-modal LLMs in Video Analysis
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「高质量标注数据稀缺与规模成本瓶颈、对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Video-MME** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we introduce Video-MME, the first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **Video-MME**。实验设计与验证细节：In this paper, we introduce Video-MME, the first-ever full-spectrum, Multi-Modal Evaluation benchmark of MLLMs in Video analysis。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（With Video-MME, we extensively evaluate various state-of-the-art MLLMs, including GPT-4 series and Gemini 1.5 Pro,...；Our experiments reveal that Gemini 1.5 Pro is the best-performing commercial model, significantly outperforming...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 26 赞），本工作可作为评估 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Kaleido Diffusion: Improving Conditional Diffusion Models with Autoregressive Latent Modeling
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Kaleido Diffusion** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖扩散模型（Diffusion Model）。核心论点主张：To address this issue, we present Kaleido, a novel approach that enhances the diversity of samples by incorporating autoregressive latent priors。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To address this issue, we present Kaleido, a novel approach that enhances the diversity of samples by incorporating autoregressive latent priors。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our experimental results demonstrate that Kaleido effectively broadens the diversity of the generated image...；Furthermore, we show that Kaleido adheres closely to the guidance provided by the generated latent variables,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 16 赞），本工作为突破 **图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: 4Diffusion: Multi-view Video Diffusion Model for 4D Generation

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance compared to previous methods）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 15 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: 4-bit Shampoo for Memory-Efficient Network Training
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**高效推理与系统**（Efficiency & Sys）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」痛点，作者围绕 **4-bit Shampoo for Memory-Efficient Network** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖高效推理与系统（Efficiency & Sys）。核心论点主张：In this paper, we propose the first 4-bit second-order optimizers, exemplified by 4-bit Shampoo, maintaining performance similar to that of 32-bit ones。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用底层算子融合、量化压缩与执行流加速、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To address this, compressing 32-bit optimizer states to lower bitwidths has shown promise in reducing memory usage。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that quantizing the eigenvector matrix of the preconditioner in 4-bit Shampoo is remarkably better than...；Evaluation on various networks for image classification demonstrates that our 4-bit Shampoo achieves comparable...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 12 赞），本工作为突破 **高效推理与系统** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
